version_guard: Verify the published version v1.11 before reading results.

scoring.metric: Score (0-100): average of all chapter scores plus the final scored piece across 14 rubric dimensions, with the forced poetry/metaphor criterion weighted 5x and a long-context degradation penalty applied
scoring.notes: Values retain this source implementation and score convention; different harnesses, subsets, judge revisions and versions must remain separate.

description: LLM-judged benchmark in which models plan and write a short story/novella over 8x 1000-word turns, scored 0-100 across 14 rubric dimensions.
